verdict.rationale: Tavily's pricing page and Python quick-start both document a free tier of 1,000 API credits per month with no credit card required. The SDK also offers a keyless mode that runs search() and extract() against the public API with no key at all, and a Development environment with a 100 RPM rate limit suits prototyping. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the free credits and keyless mode work as described.
